title: Lunatico connection poll can overwrite a queued focuser request
summary: Accepted Lunatico POSITION/STEPS intent is preserved until its queued worker starts. Old initial/external polls retain measured private position without overwriting requested public target/state; compensation and abort/disconnect ownership are coordinated. Both generated exports are versioned and covered by deterministic held-poll regression tests.
evidence: 20261024193016-8158-fix-lunatico-request-race/verification.md and quality-review.md; unchanged-driver held-poll GOTO/SYNC failures, exact-command/arrival regressions across both exports, serial and UDP, and sanitizer checks.

resolution.evidence: 20261024193016-8158-fix-lunatico-request-race/verification.md; queued request snapshots, synchronized publication and cancellation, fresh private readback, final complete recorded simulator verification.
